```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Root locator: knitr renders with cwd set to the vignettes directory, so
# the package root is found by walking up to the source tree that carries
# the fixture generators and the committed evidence.
.pkg_root <- function() {
  for (dd in c(".", "..", "../..")) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(dd, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        file.exists(file.path(dd, "R", "treatment-report.R")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(dd, "tests", "testthat"))) return(normalizePath(dd))
  }
  NA_character_
}
PKG <- .pkg_root()
# Dual-load idiom shared with the bench/scenarios drivers: the source tree
# (check and site-build contexts) loads through pkgload; a bare installed
# package (reader-side) loads through library().
if (!is.na(PKG) && requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(pkgload::load_all(PKG, quiet = TRUE,
                                                      export_all = TRUE)))
} else {
  library(msuiter)
}
# load_all does not process the NAMESPACE S3method directives (see
# bench/scenarios/run_treatment.R); register the report methods locally so
# dispatch behaves identically in both load paths.
for (m in c("print.MsTreatmentReport", "as.data.frame.MsTreatmentReport",
            "print.MsHrdReport", "as.data.frame.MsHrdReport")) {
  if (exists(m, envir = asNamespace("msuiter"), inherits = FALSE)) {
    assign(m, get(m, envir = asNamespace("msuiter")), envir = globalenv())
  }
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

msuiter's paper pillar 3 is the application-scenario layer: end-to-end
workflows that adjudicate against planted truth or an independent oracle and
persist their evidence tables. The six executable drivers live under
`bench/scenarios/` (`run_atlas.R`, `run_hrd.R`, `run_treatment.R`,
`run_qc_artifacts.R`, `run_stratify.R`, `run_downsample.R`; committed
evidence under `bench/scenarios/out/`, each driver ends in its own
OVERALL PASS or OVERALL FAIL verdict line). This page runs one reduced,
runnable snippet of each against the same committed fixture generators the
drivers use, and cross-checks the live output against the committed evidence
table whenever that table is on disk. The browsable census of the committed
evidence is the [scenario gallery](scenarios-gallery.html); this
page's own [HRD dual-oracle leg](#byte-exact-hrd-adjudication-against-the-dual-oracles)
pins those tables byte for byte.

## Atlas mode: the full cohort adjudication

The atlas scenario plants a synthetic cohort — five variant classes, known
channel plan, known arm differential — then drives the public faces and
adjudicates against the a-priori generator truth. The snippet reproduces the
ingestion-and-tally core; the committed driver adds the class roster,
extraction, hungarian fidelity and association legs with their verdict lines.
The cohort generator below is the very one the driver and the governance
tests share (`tests/testthat/helper-atlas.R`), so the numbers are the same
bytes, not a lookalike.

```{r atlas, message = FALSE}
if (is.na(PKG)) {
  cat("rendered outside the package root: the fixture generators are not reachable here\n")
} else {
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-tally.R"))
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-atlas.R"))
  fx <- .atlas_cohort(dir = file.path(tempdir(), "tour-atlas"))
  truth <- fx$truth
  mv <- ms_variants(fx$variants, genome = "synth", caller = "atlas-synth",
                    matched_normal = "none")
  cat1 <- ms_tally(mv, genome = fx$twobit, mode = "SBS96")
  cat("samples:", ncol(cat1@counts), " channels:", nrow(cat1@counts),
      " planted:", paste(.ATLAS_PLANTED, collapse = ","), "\n")
  cat("SBS96 plan exactness:",
      identical(rowSums(cat1@counts)[truth$sbs_labels],
                colSums(truth$sbs_plan)), "\n")
  ev <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out", "counts_sbs.csv")
  if (file.exists(ev)) {
    ref <- read.csv(ev, row.names = 1L, check.names = FALSE)
    cat("live run vs committed evidence", ev, ": maxabs delta =",
        max(abs(as.matrix(cat1@counts) - as.matrix(as.matrix(ref)))), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("committed evidence table not on disk (check tarball): the driver output lives in the repository under bench/scenarios/out/\n")
  }
}
```

The committed tables for this leg:
`bench/scenarios/out/counts_sbs.csv`, `counts_dbs.csv`, `qc_report.csv`,
`compare_sweep.csv`, `pbr.csv`, `prevalence.csv`, `association.csv`.
The headline committed table `counts_sbs.csv` is the 96-channel x 24-sample
SBS grid — rows and columns re-derived from the witness bytes themselves by
the gallery census face, each cell adjudicated against planted synthetic truth.

## Byte-exact HRD: adjudication against the dual oracles

The HRD leg reproduces Cortes-Castro's published values (PMID 31151873) <!-- ms-num kind="citation" reason="PMID 31151873: external published reference, not our measurement" -->
pLOH-by-segment-integration and the aneuploidy count, and every adjudicated
row must be *byte-identical* to the independent oracle implementation carried
in `tests/testthat/helper-hrd.R`. The planted geometry encodes the composite
claim: only the double-positive sample (pLOH-high **and** aneuploid) scores
HRD.

```{r hrd, message = FALSE}
if (is.na(PKG)) {
  cat("rendered outside the package root: the oracle fixtures are not reachable here\n")
} else {
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-hrd.R"))
  chr_size <- .HRD_TEST_CHR_SIZE
  arms <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("chr1", "chr2", "chr13", "chr17", "chr22"),
    function(ch) data.frame(chrom = c(ch, ch), location = c("p", "q"),
      arm_start = c(1L, chr_size %/% 2L + 1L),
      arm_end = c(chr_size %/% 2L, chr_size), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  whole <- function(sample, chrom, state, minor)
    .make_hrd_segments(sample, chrom, start = 1L, end = chr_size,
                       state = state, minor_cn = minor)
  segs <- do.call(rbind, c(
    lapply(c("chr1", "chr2", "chr13", "chr17", "chr22"),
           function(ch) whole("H1", ch, 5L, 0L)),
    lapply(c("chr1", "chr2", "chr13", "chr17", "chr22"),
           function(ch) whole("H3", ch, 3L, 1L)),
    list(.make_hrd_segments("H2", "chr1", start = 1L, end = 450000L,
                            state = 2L, minor_cn = 0L),
         whole("H4", "chr1", 2L, 1L))))
  report <- ms_hrd_report(segs, genome = "GRCh37", caller = "ascat",
                          assay = "wgs", chr_size = chr_size,
                          arms = arms, ploidy = 2)
  rows <- as.data.frame(report)
  rows <- rows[order(rows$sample), , drop = FALSE]
  print(rows[c("sample", "ploh_fraction", "aneuploidy_count",
               "hrd_score", "evidence_tier")])
  oracle_ok <- TRUE
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    sub <- segs[segs$sample == rows$sample[i], , drop = FALSE]
    oracle_ok <- oracle_ok &&
      identical(rows$ploh_fraction[i], .hrd_ref_ploh(sub, chr_size)) &&
      identical(rows$aneuploidy_count[i],
                .hrd_ref_aneuploidy_count(sub, arms, 2, rm_black_arms = FALSE))
  }
  cat("dual-oracle byte-exactness:", oracle_ok, "\n")
  stopifnot(isTRUE(oracle_ok))
  stopifnot(identical(rows$hrd_score[rows$sample == "H1"], 1L) &&
            all(rows$hrd_score[rows$sample != "H1"] == 0L))
  ev <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out", "hrd_report.csv")
  if (file.exists(ev)) {
    ref <- read.csv(ev, check.names = FALSE)
    cat("live run vs committed evidence", ev, ":",
        identical(as.integer(ref$hrd_score), rows$hrd_score) &&
        identical(as.character(ref$sample), rows$sample), "\n")
  }
}
```

A missing arm table degrades to attestation, never fabrication: the
`coverage_note` ledger names the missing input and `aneuploidy_count`
stays at zero rather than being invented. The committed table for this leg:
`bench/scenarios/out/hrd_report.csv`.

## Treatment forensics: association plus clonal timing

No mainstream signature tool offers a treatment-history reporting module.
msuiter's face fits the governed therapy classes (temozolomide, platinum,
thiopurine) against the officially recognised signature identities served
from the sealed bundled COSMIC v3.6 reference, adjudicates each cell by a
bootstrap contrast clearing an effect-size floor, and splits the exposed
mean into clonal/subclonal timing shares. The snippet runs the complete
face on the committed synthetic cohort; the degradation faces (no treatment
records, no clonality) return honest empty tables plus an attestation
ledger, never invented rows.

```{r treatment, message = FALSE}
if (is.na(PKG)) {
  cat("rendered outside the package root: the cohort generator is not reachable here\n")
} else {
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-treatment.R"))
  fx <- .ms_trt_cohort()
  sigs <- sort(unique(unlist(.MS_TRT_MAP, use.names = FALSE)))
  clon <- expand.grid(sample = fx$samples, signature = sigs)
  clon <- clon[c("sample", "signature")]
  clon$clonal_fraction <- 0.5
  rep1 <- ms_treatment_report(fx$catalog, fx$treatments, clonality = clon,
                              n_boot = 200, seed = 7)
  print(rep1)
  tab <- as.data.frame(rep1)
  cat("association rows:", nrow(tab), " adjudicated associated:",
      sum(tab$is_associated), "\n")
  prov <- attr(rep1, "provenance")
  cat("provenance: refdb", prov$refdb_version, "build", prov$build,
      "method", prov$method, "n_boot", prov$n_boot, "seed", prov$seed, "\n")
  truth_ok <- all(tab$is_associated == vapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i)
    fx$planted_truth(tab$treatment[i], tab$signature[i]), logical(1)))
  cat("planted-fidelity adjudication:", truth_ok, "\n")
  stopifnot(isTRUE(truth_ok))
  ev <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out", "treatment_association.csv")
  if (file.exists(ev)) {
    ref <- read.csv(ev, check.names = FALSE)
    cat("live run vs committed evidence", ev, ":",
        nrow(ref) == nrow(tab) &&
        identical(as.logical(ref$is_associated), as.logical(tab$is_associated)),
        "\n")
  }
}
```

The committed tables for this leg:
`bench/scenarios/out/treatment_association.csv`,
`treatment_timing.csv`. The recognition anchors and the adjudication-floor
rationale are documented at the face's manual page
(`?ms_treatment_report`) and in the Phase-8 design memo under
`vignettes/articles/devlog-*.qmd`.

## Artifact forensics: built-in sentries against planted spikes

The fourth leg runs the certified artifact-QC faces over the CS-4 planted
cohort (four C>A oxoG-reading spikes, four C>T FFPE-deamination spikes,
clean and dead controls, roster-inflated refit exposures) and cross-checks
every adjudication column against the committed witness bytes, rebuilt
from the committed plant tables.

```{r qc-artifacts, message = FALSE}
out <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out")
if (dir.exists(out)) {
  lab <- as.character(msuiter:::.ms_io_channel_tables()$SBS96)
  counts <- read.csv(file.path(out, "qc_plant_counts.tsv"), header = TRUE,
                     sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
  samples <- names(counts)[-1L]
  mat <- matrix(as.integer(unlist(counts[-1L], use.names = FALSE)),
                nrow = 96L, dimnames = list(lab, samples))
  cat0 <- ms_catalog(mat, list(name = "SBS96", labels = lab), samples,
                     provenance = list(genome = "GRCh37"))
  sen <- ms_qc_sentries(cat0)
  wit <- read.csv(file.path(out, "qc_sentries.csv"), header = TRUE,
                  check.names = FALSE)
  cat("built-in sentries, live vs committed witnesses:",
      identical(sen$gt_verdict, wit$gt_verdict) &&
      identical(sen$ct_verdict, wit$ct_verdict) &&
      identical(sen$qc_flag, wit$qc_flag), "\n")
}
```

The committed tables for this leg: `bench/scenarios/out/qc_sentries.csv`,
`qc_artifact_share.csv`, `qc_provenance.csv` with their plant tables
`qc_plant_counts.tsv`, `qc_plant_dict.tsv`, `qc_plant_exposures.tsv`.
The certified backing and the declined-scope rails are the manual pages
(`?ms_qc_sentries`, `?ms_qc_roster_share`, `?ms_qc_provenance`) and the
scenario devlog under `vignettes/articles/devlog-*-p3-cs4-*.qmd`.

## Stratification decision: the frozen GMM cutoff adjudicated

The fifth leg runs the certified SigProfiler-frozen stratification face
(a faithful upstream replication under the platform's Framing-B posture --
the object is the decision record the M2 stages will consume) over the CS-5
planted cohort: order-of-magnitude hypermutants planted on a jittered
bimodal bulk must be caught at full recall and precision, the manual floor
must re-adjudicate with the boundary measured strict, and the certified
silence and degenerate branches must speak. Every adjudication column is
cross-checked against the committed witness bytes, rebuilt from the
committed plant.

```{r stratify, message = FALSE}
out <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out")
if (dir.exists(out)) {
  plant <- read.csv(file.path(out, "stratify_plant_totals.tsv"),
                    header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  totals <- setNames(as.numeric(plant$total), plant$sample)
  st <- ms_stratify_hypermutants(totals, seed = 1)
  part <- read.csv(file.path(out, "stratify_partition.csv"),
                   header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  scal <- read.csv(file.path(out, "stratify_scalars.csv"),
                   header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  caught <- part$sample[as.integer(part$is_hyper) == 1L]
  cat("planted roster caught at recall/precision 1:",
      identical(st@hyper, caught) &&
        identical(st@hyper, plant$sample[as.integer(plant$planted_hyper) == 1L]),
      "\n")
  cat("cutoff and partition vs committed witnesses:",
      identical(st@cutoff, as.numeric(scal$cutoff)) &&
        identical(as.integer(part$is_hyper),
                  as.integer(plant$sample %in% st@hyper)), "\n")
  fl <- read.csv(file.path(out, "stratify_floor.csv"),
                 header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  ff <- fl[fl$regime == "floored", , drop = FALSE]
  fb <- setNames(as.numeric(ff$total), ff$sample)
  stf <- ms_stratify_hypermutants(fb, manual_cutoff = as.integer(ff$manual_cutoff[1L]),
                                  seed = 1)
  cat("floored regime re-adjudicates with a strict boundary:",
      identical(as.integer(ff$is_hyper), as.integer(ff$sample %in% stf@hyper)) &&
        identical(stf@cutoff, as.numeric(ff$manual_cutoff[1L])), "\n")
}
```

The committed tables for this leg: `bench/scenarios/out/stratify_scalars.csv`,
`stratify_partition.csv`, `stratify_floor.csv`, `stratify_degenerate.csv`
with the plant `stratify_plant_totals.tsv`. The certified backing -- the
frozen upstream rule, the twin parity battery and the declined-scope rails
-- are the manual pages (`?ms_stratify_hypermutants`,
`?plot_hypermutator_burden`) and the scenario devlog under
`vignettes/articles/devlog-*-p3-cs5-*.qmd`.

## Downsample frontier: the committed thinning ladder adjudicated

The sixth leg runs the common-depth thinner `ms_downsample` -- the data-
preparation face carrying the shipped sanity protocol's one thinning law --
across the frozen depth ladder, and adjudicates the pooled presence face
`ms_test_presence` (likelihood-ratio statistic, Benjamini-Hochberg over the
planted dictionary) against the planted truth. Strong signatures must hold
full pooled recall on every rung, the planted-zero control must stay at
census zero everywhere, and the borderline signature's verdict must be
monotone along the ladder with its last passing depth COMMITTED as an
observed fact. The thinning's byte laws adjudicate alongside: verbatim-keep
at the boundary, exact clamp above it, dead columns undisturbed, honest
provenance counts. Every check below re-runs live against the committed
witness bytes.

```{r downsample, message = FALSE}
out <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out")
if (dir.exists(out)) {
  plant <- read.csv(file.path(out, "cs6_plant.csv"),
                    header = TRUE, row.names = 1L, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  counts <- as.matrix(plant)
  lad <- read.csv(file.path(out, "cs6_ladder.csv"),
                  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  scal <- read.csv(file.path(out, "cs6_scalars.csv"),
                   header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  dict_names <- strsplit(scal$dict_roster, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  refdb <- ms_refdb_bundled(build = "GRCh37")
  mat <- refdb[["SBS_GRCh37"]]@matrices[[1L]]
  dict <- sweep(mat[, dict_names, drop = FALSE], 2L,
                colSums(mat[, dict_names, drop = FALSE]), "/")
  samples <- names(plant)
  cat <- ms_catalog(counts = counts,
                    channels = list(name = "SBS96", labels = rownames(plant)),
                    samples = samples,
                    provenance = list(genome = "committed"))
  depths <- unlist(strsplit(scal$depths, ",", fixed = TRUE))
  bits_ok <- all(vapply(as.integer(depths), function(d) {
    pres <- ms_test_presence(ms_downsample(cat, depth = d,
                                           seed = as.integer(scal$ladder_seed)),
                             signatures = dict,
                             nb_size = as.integer(scal$nb_size))
    witnessed <- as.integer(lad$pass_bh[lad$depth == d])
    identical(witnessed, as.integer(pres$pass_bh))
  }, logical(1)))
  cat("ladder verdicts re-derive the committed bits rung by rung:",
      bits_ok, "\n")
  strong_bits <- lad$pass_bh[lad$signature %in% c("SBS1", "SBS5")]
  ctrl_bits <- lad$pass_bh[lad$signature == "SBS18"]
  cat("planted-extremes rails hold (full recall, census zero):",
      all(strong_bits == 1L) && all(ctrl_bits == 0L), "\n")
  bou <- read.csv(file.path(out, "cs6_boundary.csv"),
                  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("boundary witness clamps and keeps as committed:",
      identical(as.integer(bou$post_total),
                as.integer(pmin(as.integer(bou$total),
                                as.integer(scal$bound_depth)))) &&
        identical(as.integer(bou$is_dead),
                  as.integer(as.integer(bou$total) == 0L)), "\n")
}
```

The committed tables for this leg: `bench/scenarios/out/cs6_plant.csv`,
`cs6_ladder.csv`, `cs6_boundary.csv`, `cs6_scalars.csv` and
`cs6_degenerates.tsv`. The certified backing -- the thinning law's single
wording, the presence face's manual and the declined-scope rails -- are the
manual pages (`?ms_downsample`, `?ms_test_presence`) and the scenario devlog
under `vignettes/articles/devlog-*-p3-cs6-*.qmd`.

## Reproducing the full verdicts

Each driver prints its own adjudication lines and exits zero only on
OVERALL PASS:

```{sh verdicts, eval = FALSE}
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_atlas.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_hrd.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_treatment.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_qc_artifacts.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_stratify.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_downsample.R
```
